semiconductor_relevance: Medium — the company specializes in optoelectronic sensors that can be used in semiconductor manufacturing processes, but is not a direct semiconductor supplier.
summary: Takenaka Electronic Industrial manufactures optoelectronic sensors and control equipment that enhance safety and efficiency in semiconductor manufacturing processes. Their products include explosion-proof sensors for resist coating and cleaning, as well as color sensors for LED applications, contributing to increased productivity.
capabilities: Color sensors for LED color discrimination
Force Sensitive Sheet Sensor KSS85 Series for object gripping and presence checking
